title: publish-release.sh must refuse at staging when CHANGELOG.md at the receipt's commit has no section for the version
description: For the NEXT lore/quest pair (filing only, not built; opum-doc ruling relay 894 via team-lead, 2026-10-20, DEC-182). Today the missing-CHANGELOG-heading refusal exists only at promotion: scripts/promote-latest.mjs:1558-1568 reads CHANGELOG.md at the commit the tag peels to and refuses when it has no non-empty "## [X]" section (releaseNotesFor, scripts/github-release.mjs:363). scripts/publish-release.sh has no such read (its only mention, line 270, is a comment) and release.yml has only the breaking-entry-vs-bump gate, so a tag lacking the heading can be staged to npm and is caught only when latest would move. Change: publish-release.sh refuses at STAGING, before any registry write, when CHANGELOG.md at the receipt commit has no non-empty "## [<version>]" section, reading the committed bytes (never the checkout) with the same helper promote-latest uses. promote-latest keeps its refusal. Touches scripts/, so it needs a reviewer pass.

acceptanceCriteria.text: publish-release.sh refuses before any registry write when CHANGELOG.md at the receipt commit has no non-empty section for the version, naming the version and the commit
it reads the committed bytes at that commit via the same helper promote-latest uses, never the checkout copy
proved both ways: a commit with the section stages, a commit without it refuses, and a mutation of the check goes red
promote-latest.mjs refusal unchanged and its tests still pass
